brief.prompt: Close-up editorial photo of a person standing at a bathroom mirror, hair pulled fully back with a soft headband, glasses held in one hand away from the face, checking their own reflection with a calm neutral expression. Natural window light, shallow depth of field, the reflected face slightly out of focus so the focus stays on the careful, unhurried check.
brief.alt: A person with their hair pulled back studies their face in a mirror while holding a pair of glasses in one hand
brief.purpose: Illustrates the quick mirror check in the section on confirming your face shape: hair back, straight-on view, neutral expression, before choosing frames.

review.alt: A person in a white robe and soft headband, hair pulled back, holds a pair of tortoiseshell glasses away from their face while studying their calm reflection in a bathroom mirror by a sunlit window.
